chapters.title: Chapter 833: Honglian Wudi Ni Qianzhou
paragraphs: While thinking.
Su Lang carefully checked the red lotus with mental power, mainly to find the formation above.
Unfortunately, there is no formation on this regular red lotus.
It is a pure treasure condensed from perfect fire rules.
Perhaps, arranging the formation on this red lotus is superfluous.
If the formation of other attributes is arranged, it will even cause a series of conflicts, which is even worse.
"What a good treasure."
Su Lang smiled faintly, and before Zhong Mu could speak, his eyes fell on the city under the giant red lotus.
This city is boundless, it is a veritable imperial city!
The city is also dominated by red, and there is no city wall, but the formation is used as a barrier.
The scene in the city, because of the barriers of the formation, became vague, difficult to inspect, and even mental power could not detect it.
However, Su Lang was not interested in the scenes in the city at this time.
His eyes fixed on the guard formation!
It was a combined formation, consisting of three emperor-level formations, 72 immortal-level formations, and 4,900 holy-level formations.
Different from the rule of red lotus treasure, this formation has mixed attributes and has various kinds.
The warrior who arranged the formation must have the knowledge of the emperor-level formation mage, but this formation was still full of flaws in the eyes of Su Lang.
Many of the formations are very obscure, even forcibly mixed, leaving serious problems.
Even without the ability to control the formation, Su Lang had a way to attack the weakness of the formation, gradually paralyzing it.
Of course, this requires a lot of effort and a lot of time, and it is totally thankless.
Su Lang ignored the weaknesses of the formations, analyzed the entire giant imperial formation, looked at each formation and learned all of them.
Not long.
The three emperor-level formations, the seventy-two immortal formations and the 4,900 saint-level formations have all been learned by Su Lang.
As long as the materials are sufficient, he can arrange them all with a thought.
Finished learning the formation.
Su Lang looked at Zhongmu.
This quasi immortal stayed there all the time, it seemed that because of his shallow cultivation and low status, he did not dare to talk to Su Lang.
Seeing Su Lang looking at him, he bowed down and saluted and asked, "Dare to ask Lord Lang if he wants to enter the city, and the younger generation will report to Lord Honglian Wudi."
Su Lang smiled and was about to refuse.
But at this moment.
A black figure appeared on the Red Lotus Rule Supreme, a few flashes, and came to Su Lang.
"Hahahaha."
"Unexpectedly, the Langdi Daoist Friends will visit the Red Lotus Imperial City in person, and please forgive me if you missed it."
The person here is a middle-aged man, his height and face are about the same as ordinary humans, and his ethnicity is characterized by lotus-shaped pupils.
He is dressed in black mysterious clothes, simple but not simple, wearing a crown of vermilion lotus, and long dark red hair.
As for his identity.
From the rule of red lotus, he looks like a master, and he also calls Su Lang a daoist friend. It goes without saying that he is the red lotus emperor!
"Honglian Wudi!?"
"It seems to be approachable, not overbearing."
It was the first time that Su Lang saw the real Emperor Wu, he couldn't help his expression, then silently opened the opponent's attribute panel.
[Name]: Ni Qianzhou
[Race]: Honglian Emperor Clan
[Qualification Level]: Unparalleled
[Realm level]: Second Rank Wudi
[Attack level]: Second Rank Wudi+
[Defensive Level]: Second Rank Wudi
[Shenfa Level]: Second Rank Wudi
[Endurance Level]: Second Rank Wudi
[Spirit Level]: Realm of Kongni

[Mastering the exercises]: Red Lotus Sutra, Red Lotus Zhao Shidi Sutra (Emperor level, Xiaocheng), Wuxiang Furong Xianjue (Xian-level, perfection), Wugou Hao Ti Xianjue (Xian-level, perfection), No Xie Luo Shen Zhen Jing (Xian-level, Consummation), Ksitigarbha (Xian-level, Consummation), Jingchen Xian Jing (Xian-level, Consummation)
"Ni Qianzhou? You owe a beating?"
"The name is a little bit happy."
With a hint of playfulness, Su Lang analyzed the attributes panel of Emperor Wu Lian.

chapters.title: Chapter 834: Spiritual Realm Kongni
paragraphs: "Unparalleled capital."
"Sure enough, if you want to become an emperor, you have the highest probability of being an emperor. After all, you are an emperor."
"I don't know how many years Ni Qianzhou has lived, and he has only reached the second level of Emperor Wu. It seems that Emperor Wu's realm can hardly be ascended to the sky."
"The spiritual realm is'empty nirvana'? This is the spiritual realm after the sunlit realm? I don't know what characteristics it has. After emptiness, what realm will it be?"

"There is only one emperor level exercise method, and it seems to be inherited from the ancestors. Also, those who can hold multiple emperor level exercise methods must be the best among Emperor Wu. Ni Qianzhou is obviously just an ordinary Emperor Wu."

"There are five immortal level exercises practiced, no more, no less. It seems to be a series, and there is no other five element attributes. It seems that Ni Qianzhou is more worried about the conflict of exercises."
"Yes, he was originally the emperor of the fire system, so he naturally wanted to specialize in the purest fire system rules."
While Su Lang was looking at Ni Qianzhou, Ni Qianzhou was also looking at Su Lang.
"Is this the clone of Emperor Lang?"
"I don't know what exercises he has cultivated, he has so many rules and powers, it's so complicated!"
"It seems...In addition to the five element rules, I have comprehended a lot of more profound rules, and there are even more spatial rules."
"Di Langdi, is this a martial immortal who wants to cultivate this clone into a perfect foundation? As a second flesh body? But this is too weird."
"Ordinary Wuxian also comprehend the five elements rules and other necessary rules, plus some derivative rules.

At most, if you can comprehend some other rules that are easier to comprehend to supplement, you have already exhausted your mind, and your life is near, and you have to give up comprehension of rules and concentrate on breaking through the realm. "
"More Wuxians just reach the threshold of breakthrough, understand the five elements rules and various necessary rules, and directly seek breakthrough opportunities.
"The more rules there are, the more conflicts there will be, unless...unless all the rules that are close to the real world can be perfected to solve this problem..."
"Furthermore, if this clone is to be regarded as a second flesh body, it is most likely to become an emperor again in the future."
"But Emperor Cheng needs to choose the rule road. Generally, only one is enough to pursue it with his life's efforts."
"The more and deeper the rules of comprehension, although it can play a role in comprehending by analogy, but incomprehensible and inaccurate, it is an obstacle to the consolidation of the road."
"It's impossible for Emperor Lang to not know this, maybe he is...just want to cultivate this clone into an existence that is invincible in the fairyland?"
"But, what's the use of just being invincible in Martial Fairyland? It's not as good as a finger of the deity."
Regarding Su Lang's avatar, Ni Qianzhou saw a lot of things that ordinary warriors couldn't see, and thought about it a lot. At this time, he was a little puzzled.
Not enough, he was not too entangled.
Emperor Wu is invincible in the Canglan Continent and will basically not fall.
Therefore, in the long years, it is normal to make some incredible attempts.
However, Emperor Honglian Wu didn't know that Su Lang's clone was exactly the same as his deity.
He thought that this clone was just a special case of Su Lang's deity to experiment, but he never thought that Su Lang's deity was like this.
It seems that a long time has passed since the Emperor Wu Lian stepped into the air to meet the two.
But the collision of thoughts was only an instant, and after thinking so much, it was actually a blink of an eye.
"Long admiring the name of Emperor Honglian Wu."
Su Lang smiled, "When I saw it, it was really extraordinary.
"Langdi is overwhelmed."
Ni Qianzhou also smiled kindly, "Friends of the Taoist come from afar, it's my distinguished guest. I have to treat him well. Come, let me go to the city for a while."
"it is good."
Su Lang smiled and nodded.
His purpose of coming here has been achieved. He originally planned to leave here, but he didn't expect Emperor Wulian to run over to meet him.
At this time, Emperor Honglian Wu invited him to take a look inside the city, but he couldn't refuse.
So, let's go into the city and have a look!
Just look at how extraordinary this magnificent Wudi City is.
"please!"
Ni Qianzhou stretched out his hand to ask, and then led the way.
"please!"
Su Lang followed suit with a smile on his face.
It seems to be taking care of Su Ge's avatar's "cultivation base is still shallow", so Ni Qianzhou walked very slowly, just like an ordinary person walks.

chapters.title: Chapter 835: Shopping with Emperor Wu
paragraphs: The two walked in the air like this, slowly walking towards the Red Lotus Imperial City.
As for Zhongmu, although he can be appointed by Ni Qianzhou and his identity may be unique, he is not yet qualified to walk with the two emperors.
Well, even though Su Lang is not Emperor Wu, everyone thinks so now.
The three messengers did not return, but the information had been sent back long ago.
Even the Emperor Wu Palace recognized the identity of Emperor Wu Su Lang.
Of course, all Wudi still had doubts about the origin of Su Lang, the new Wudi.
Therefore, although Emperor Wu of Honglian was kind, he did not take Su Lang to his Red Lotus Lair as a guest, only to his imperial city.
Not long.
The two came outside the Red Lotus Emperor City.
Entering the city is naturally very simple. Ni Qianzhou said hello casually, and the warriors who guarded the formation were busy opening up.
Someone flattered, but was driven away by Ni Qianzhou.
Immediately after.
Ni Qianzhou changed for a while, no longer what he was like before, as if he didn't want to cause a sensation in the city.
"Let's start walking from this south gate."
Ni Qianzhou smiled and invited Su Lang to go forward with him.
When I arrived in the city, the scene inside was clear at a glance.
Everywhere I saw peculiar high-rise buildings, row upon row, ridges and mountains, no less than those prosperous cities of Su Lang's previous Blue Star.
The wide streets stretch from east to west, north to south, and ordinary roads are eight lanes wide, even in small alleys, there are two lanes wide.
The ground is all paved with jade, exuding a touch of aura, in the eyes of low-level warriors, this is a good thing.
The buildings of the Red Lotus clan are mostly decorated with red lotus flowers, and even the buildings themselves use the appearance of red lotus.
The iconic building in the imperial city is a huge lotus building with a total of 900 floors, which is connected to the bottom of the ruled red lotus.
In places such as squares, there must be huge red lotus and red lotus statues of Emperor Wu himself. They are tall and magnificent, making people look up.
Looking down on the whole city from a height, it is like looking at an endless sea of red lotus.
Su Lang and Ni Qianzhou walked side by side on the street, like other ordinary warriors.
Look around.
On the streets, warriors come and go.
It can be said that god-level warriors walk all over the floor, and noble-level warriors are inferior to dogs.
There are also many saint-level martial artists, and Su Lang even saw a martial immortal.
The warriors here seem to like to raise a spirit beast similar to a unicorn.
This spirit beast is white all over, but has four hooves vermilion, a red crown and horns on its head, and its ears are like lotus petals.
When they opened their mouths, two rows of fine red teeth could be seen.
However, not all appearances are like this, and some have variegated colors and seem to be impure.
This kind of spirit beast has very strong potential, ranging from king rank to rank, and even holy rank.
The Martial Immortal that Su Lang saw was riding a holy spirit beast, and the surrounding martial artists were all envious and awed.
Look at the surrounding shops.
There are all kinds of industries, no less than the prosperous city of Su Lang's previous Blue Star.
"How is my city?"
Ni Qianzhou saw that Su Lang looked left and right with great interest and couldn't help but asked with a smile.
At the beginning of the establishment of this city, he has spent a lot of effort, if he can get the approval of another Martial Emperor, then he will be very happy.
"It's really majestic, more prosperous than any city on my mainland fragment."

The two Eight Tribulations Martial Immortals respectfully knelt at Su Lang's feet.
"Yuehong, what's the matter, I will say later."
Su Lang looked indifferent, "Calling you to come together is to fulfill my promise and wait for you to improve your cultivation base, Yuehong, you come forward."
"Yes!"
Fairy Yuehong cautiously came to Su Lang and knelt down again.
Su Lang didn't say much, pressing directly on Yue Hong's forehead with his hand.
Being pressed against Su Lang's forehead, Rao is the Yuehong Fairy, also a little nervous.
In her mind, she kept wondering what way Su Lang would use to improve her cultivation, how many days it would take...
But before she could think of one, two, three, she suddenly felt a huge energy poured into her body.
That is a kind of energy that directly integrates into one's own cultivation base without digestion, as if it should be one's own cultivation base.
"What an anti-sky method is this!?"
Fairy Yuehong's eyes widened, her expression unbelievable.
She felt that her long-standing cultivation base was like a wild horse running out of the way, rushing towards the realm of Nine Tribulations Wuxian.
That kind of speed is really too fast, it's as if one's body is full of it all at once!
Immediately afterwards, the bottleneck broke open, and Yuehongwu Immortal body uploaded to break through the fluctuations.
She officially broke through to the realm of Nine Tribulations Wuxian.
This also made her feeling of being jammed disappear suddenly, feeling a sense of loss.
However, it didn't take long before the feeling of being jammed came again!
Then there was another breakthrough, Yuehong Wuxian broke through to the realm of Zhundi!
Su Lang was still exporting wildly, and the cultivation base was poured into the Yuehong female fairy without any money, pushing her cultivation base to the peak of the Emperor Zhun.
Not long.
The aura on Yuehong Wuxian's body finally stagnated, firmly at the pinnacle of Emperor Zhun, no weaker than Xiao Lutian and Li Feilou.
Aside.
Li Xianyang's expression remained unchanged. In his opinion, any miracle happened to the Lord is reasonable.
But Wuxian Wuxian was dumbfounded, and even his eyes fell off.
From a mortal's cultivation to the present point, Void clearly knows how difficult it is to cultivate.
Especially in the realm of Wuxian, if there is no adventure, even if the resources are abundant, it is difficult to make progress.
After arriving in the Eight Tribulations Martial Immortal Realm, it is even more like touching the ceiling, it seems that the achievement of this life is just like that.

However, now he saw with his own eyes a Martial Immortal who was in the Eight Tribulations Realm at the same time as himself, soaring directly from the Eight Tribulations Martial Immortal to the pinnacle of Quasi Emperor within a dozen breaths!
What a heaven-defying, what a dream!
Everything looks fake!
Fairy Yuehong felt the same way, and she wondered if she was dreaming.
It wasn't until Su Lang withdrew her hand that she slightly recovered.
"Empty, it's your turn."
Su Lang turned to look at Wuxian Wuxian.

chapters.title: Chapter 843: Rebirth of the Heart of the Emperor
paragraphs: Wuxian Wuxian seemed to have lost his soul, and came to Su Lang in a daze.
His mind was so shocked that he was a little bit overwhelmed.
But the next moment.
The emptiness Wuxian drank a sip of ice in the hot summer, and he immediately awakened!
Because Su Lang resisted his forehead and began to instill the repair!
It didn't take long.
Su Lang withdrew his hand, and Wuxian Wuxian's cultivation base was also elevated to the pinnacle of quasi emperor.
"My realm, my strength!"
Wuxian Wuxian felt the majestic power in his body, and the deep sense of reality made him tremble with excitement.
Immediately after.
"Servant, thank you Lord!"
"But there is life, never hesitate to die!"
Wuxian Wuxian slammed down and almost knocked the floor.
Fairy Yuehong also knelt down and kowtow to express her gratitude.
Although she wasn't as excited as Wuxian Wuxian, she was so excited that she couldn't speak.
"Okay, get up."
Su Lang said lightly, "Do you still remember, I said I want to give you an emperor level exercise?"
"Remember...remember!!
Wuxian Wuxian tremblingly said.
Yuehong Wuxian nodded, a light burst in his eyes.
"Ok."
"Originally, I was going to give you the emperor-level exercise "Emperor Phase Without Beginning Sutra"."
"But because I made a deal with Emperor Wu Lian, the exercise was originally given to him to burn a copy."
Su Lang smiled, "So, I can only reward you with another emperor level exercise."
Wuxian Wuxian is very Yuehong Wuxian, oh no, it should be said that he is a quasi emperor.
Emptiness Zhundi and Yuehong Zhundi were nervous to death when Su Lang spoke.
Especially when Su Lang said halfway through, they all had a cardiac arrest.
After only listening to the first few sentences, I thought I couldn't get the emperor level technique, but I didn't expect a big turning point later!
"This exercise is called "Emperor Heart Reincarnation Record"!"
Su Lang's voice fell into the ears of Yuehong Zhun Emperor and Kong Xu Zhun Emperor, followed by a black plate with gold patterns printed in his vision.
It is the size of the palm of the black plate with gold patterns, and it is covered with dense and numerous golden patterns.
Even if you use mental power to observe, you don't know the number at all!
Rao Shi Yuehong and Void have reached the realm of quasi-emperor, and when they first saw the main body of "Emperor Heart Reincarnation", they were a little dizzy.
next moment.
The two of them condensed the spirit of twelve points, tried to check the golden disc, and immediately felt the endless mystery above.
"This is the emperor level technique!"
"And it's the original exercise, not a burned copy!
"Master Langdi actually rewarded me with an emperor level technique. Such a great grace can only be repaid by death!"
The same thoughts appeared in the minds of Yuehong Zhun Emperor and Kong Xu Zhun Emperor, and their faces also showed excitement and admiration.
"You take this exercise together to study and practice."
"I have some friendship with Gulian. You don't need to guard the north. You will go to guard the Fujiguitokai together."
While talking, Su Lang threw the inscription disc to Wuxian Yuehong.
He couldn't practice the practice of "The Reincarnation of the Emperor's Heart" for the time being, and it was very difficult to burn, so he simply left the original to them.
Anyway, if you want to practice in the future, just take it back and have a look.
"Yes, your servant obeys!"
Empty and busy bowing to thank you.
And the Fairy Moon Rainbow was a bit hesitant to talk.
"Yuehong, just say anything."
Su Lang looked at Yue Hong with a gentle smile.
"Master..."
Yue Hong hesitated for a while, and said, "The slave maid wants to go back to the Wuque Immortal Clan."
"what!?"
The empty Zhundi on the side was stunned at once.
Li Xianyang was also surprised, and immediately frowned slightly, somewhat dissatisfied.
This Moon Emperor Zhunhong, who had just received a reward from the Lord, wanted to leave and return to the Wuwei Immortal Clan! ?
"Tell me, why do you want to go back?"

Su Lang asked indifferently, didn't he think that Yue Hong Zhundi didn't know good or bad, because Yue Hong had even handed over his soul and heart, and it was impossible to act indiscriminately like losing his wisdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 844: Bridgehead Wuquexian Clan
paragraphs: "Return to the Lord."
"The reason why the slave servant wants to go back is to establish a stronghold in the north-central mainland for the Lord."
"The Lord has bestowed me a visit to the Wuquexian clan when I return to deal with personal affairs."
"Wuquexian Clan has been made things difficult by previous enemies because it has no power to guard, and the situation is now very bad."
"And Li Feilou is also missing. He has never returned to the Wuquexian clan to expel his enemies. The people in the clan have already complained."
"The slave and maid will receive the Lord's great favor, and reach the quasi-emperor. Once they return, they will be able to command the Immortal Clan, adding another help to the Lord.

"The South is barren after all. With the power of the Lord, it will definitely deter the Quartet. Sooner or later, if you go to the central and northern part, the Wuquexian clan will be a good bridgehead."

"Furthermore, the slave maid speculated that the Yaojin and Tianyin emperors might be dissatisfied with the lord, and the Wuwei immortal clan is also in the central and northern part. Although they can't resist the emperor, they can also inquire for some intelligence."
When Yuehong Zhundi said something, the emptiness of Zhundi suddenly realized, and Li Xianyang's expression also became better.
"Ok."
"What you said is true."
"Wuwei Xianzu is indeed a good bridgehead."
"In that case, you can go back to the Wuque Immortal Clan."
Su Lang nodded, "There is no need to guard the vine tortoise Donghai in emptiness. Go with Yuehong, and one of my clones will also go with you."
The proposal of Emperor Yuehong Zhun is very good.
Of course, Su Lang was not content to live in the southern corner.
Su Lang is bound to win the northern part of the mainland, and even the entire Canglan Continent.
Although it is still too early to mention these, it is a precaution to set up a bridgehead in advance.
"Thank you, Lord!"
Emperor Yuehong kowtow to thank you.
In fact, she is selfish, that is, the people of the Wuwei immortal clan, she can't just watch their decline and extinction.
Of course, she had already expressed this clearly, and Su Lang knew it, and didn't mind.
"From now on, there is no shortage of immortal clan. Although you two are quasi-emperors, you may not be independent.
Su Lang continued, "I will arrange for some Wuxians to go with you to increase their strength."
The Wuquexian clan that is now located in the northern part of the mainland is an empty nest.
Except for Li Feilou, all the Great Sage, Zhunxian, and Wuxian have all been put under Su Lang's command.
Emperor Zhunhong Yuehong and Emperor Zhunxuan passed by alone, they were polished commanders, and it was not easy to use their abilities.
In addition, those martial celestials staying in the sea of sky is of little use, it is better to send some past to support Yuehong and Void.
Presumably, those Wuxian immortals of the Wuquexian clan are more willing to go back.
For Su Lang's arrangement, Emperor Yuehong was very grateful, and Emperor Zhunxuan felt that the Lord was really sympathetic to his subordinates.
Unlike Xiao Lutian, even if he had more trust in his subordinates, he was cold and high above him.
"Go ahead."
Su Lang dispatched a clone and asked the clone to take Yuehong and Void Zhundi to select the manpower.
Li Xianyang also bowed and planned to retire.
But Su Lang stopped him.
"Master!"
Li Xianyang bends down in fear.
"A big power needs a steady stream of fresh blood."
"These fresh blood, in addition to soliciting from outside, is produced from within."
"Now our foundation is relatively large. There are thirteen saint races, one immortal race, and there are countless warriors."
"However, most of these warriors have been stopped before the realm of Martial God. It is difficult to go further. I intend to change this status quo."
Su Lang looked at Li Xianyang and said with a smile, "The of war condenses the space guide, which involves space rules.

However, where the of war gets the power of rules, he follows the steps by drawing the gourd and condensing the inspiration of space, but knows the nature of the inspiration of space and does not know why.
But if you understand the rules of space, you can trace the origin, know the essence of the space guide, and a faster way to understand it.
I stay with you because I want to give you a task. You have to do your best to find a way to become a more easily. "
After speaking, Su Lang looked at Li Xianyang lightly.
"The servant must complete this task!"
Li Xianyang solemnly knocked on Su Lang's commander.
"I believe you."
Su Lang smiled and nodded, and let him go down to work.

chapters.title: Chapter 845: Baiyue Emperor City!
paragraphs: Immediately after.
After practicing for a while, Su Lang used Perfect Possession to control the clone that escorted the Baiyue Emperor Clan's messenger Tai Ye.
The Baiyue Emperor Clan is northwest of here, near the deserted, icy and snowy west of Liao.
The imperial city was built on a huge snow mountain.
This snow-capped mountain, or a mountain range, cuts across the world like a wall of the world.
The size of the White Moon Imperial City is even larger than the Red Lotus Imperial City!
It can be seen that the snow mountain is such a huge monster!
If you compare Mount Everest with the previous Blue Star, it is equivalent to a small mound than Mount Tai!
The Baiyue Emperor City built on the huge snow mountain is an open city.
Anyone can enter, there are no restrictions.
Looking around, streamers flicked across the sky, coming in and out of the city like a school of fish.
Just looking at this scene, you can feel the strong sense of mixing.
This shows that the Baiyue Emperor Clan is a race with extremely strong self-confidence and extremely strong ability.
At this moment.
Tai Ye had arrived at the Wudi City of the Baiyue Emperor Clan, and Su Lang's clone was by her side.
"What a miracle city."
Su Lang looked at the endless snow-white city and couldn't help but admire.
Zhunxian Tai Ye didn't seem to have the courage to talk to Emperor Wu Su Lang, but he kept nodding his head.
Su Lang knew why this quasi immortal who was originally polite and talkative was like this.
It's entirely because the personality produced by this clone is a bit strange, and it even babbles constantly on the way to Tai Ye, teasing others, and frightening Tai Ye.
In this regard, Su Lang was also dumbfounded.
"I don't know if you are lucky enough to meet Emperor Wudi, the twins of Emperor Baiyue?"
Looking at the Baiyue Emperor City, Su Lang muttered to himself, then turned his head to look towards Tai Ye.
"Lord Langdi probably won't see it."
"But it's not that the Baiyue emperor has a high self-esteem and deliberately neglects adults."
Zhunxian Tai Ye took a breath and said cautiously: "The two Emperor Wu have been in retreat for a long time. Several Emperor Wu came to visit, but none of them saw them."
"That's it."
Su Lang nodded, "Then you go and come back to life, I will stroll around Baiyue Emperor City by myself."
"Yes! Your lord!"
Tai Ye Zhunxian bowed in relief and flew away.
As soon as Su Lang moved, he flew forward, and soon merged into a'river' composed of escape light.
This ‘river’ is made up of warriors, densely packed, flying in the sky, and it really shows what is called a fantasy world.
Su Lang entered the city smoothly, and no one even came to investigate.
Walking on the streets in the city, Su Lang found that although there were a lot of people, it was not messy, and it looked very organized.
A large number of people of different races walked on the street.
Those with horns on their heads, those with blooming foreheads, those with wings on their backs, those with four arms, those with a long tail on their buttocks...
Su Langduo glanced at the long-tailed girl, and remembered the Foxtail tribe he had seen in the Jinwen Clan Teleportation Array.
Looking at the warriors of different races coming and going around, this scene is somewhat similar to the original one.
Su Lang walked around slowly and found that the cultivation resources here are indeed much richer than those in the south.
After walking a few steps in this way, I saw several materials that I had never seen before.
And among the various resources, the resource of refining was the most abundant, which made Su Lang couldn't help but have the idea of fishing here.
"My super humanoid weapon just lacks a lot of materials."

"Although the resources of the thirteen saints and one immortal land are all collected through the exchange building, and sooner or later I can gather it, but it will take time to accumulate after all."

"In addition, I have already learned the formation of the Red Lotus Emperor clan secretly, and there is still here, and there will be the Emperor Wu Palace later, but I did not have enough materials after learning the formation, which is really a pity."
"There are many kinds of refining materials here, the quantity is large, and the price is generally low. You can do a wave!"
Su Lang licked his lips, and could no longer suppress this thought.
However, he didn't forget the business, and planned to learn the formation of the Baiyue Emperor City first.
So he rose into the air and flew towards the center of the Baiyue Emperor City.

The Baiyue Emperor City is open, but it also has a place that is not open, that is, the ‘administrative center’ here, where there are the Baiyue Emperor Clan warriors who are responsible for managing the city and deterring those with ghosts.
Su Lang soon arrived in the center of the city.
There stood a huge gate straight into the sky.
At first glance, it looks like an enlarged version of the Arc de Triomphe, but the carvings on it are completely different, revealing an ancient feeling.

sentences.text: Immediately after.
After practicing for a while, Su Lang used Perfect Possession to control the clone that escorted the Baiyue Emperor Clan's messenger Tai Ye.
The Baiyue Emperor Clan is northwest of here, near the deserted, icy and snowy west of Liao.
The imperial city was built on a huge snow mountain.
This snow-capped mountain, or a mountain range, cuts across the world like a wall of the world.
The size of the White Moon Imperial City is even larger than the Red Lotus Imperial City!
It can be seen that the snow mountain is such a huge monster!
If you compare Mount Everest with the previous Blue Star, it is equivalent to a small mound than Mount Tai!
The Baiyue Emperor City built on the huge snow mountain is an open city.
Anyone can enter, there are no restrictions.
Looking around, streamers flicked across the sky, coming in and out of the city like a school of fish.
Just looking at this scene, you can feel the strong sense of mixing.
This shows that the Baiyue Emperor Clan is a race with extremely strong self-confidence and extremely strong ability.
At this moment.
Tai Ye had arrived at the Wudi City of the Baiyue Emperor Clan, and Su Lang's clone was by her side.
"What a miracle city."
Su Lang looked at the endless snow-white city and couldn't help but admire.
Zhunxian Tai Ye didn't seem to have the courage to talk to Emperor Wu Su Lang, but he kept nodding his head.
Su Lang knew why this quasi immortal who was originally polite and talkative was like this.
It's entirely because the personality produced by this clone is a bit strange, and it even babbles constantly on the way to Tai Ye, teasing others, and frightening Tai Ye.
In this regard, Su Lang was also dumbfounded.
"I don't know if you are lucky enough to meet Emperor Wudi, the twins of Emperor Baiyue?"
Looking at the Baiyue Emperor City, Su Lang muttered to himself, then turned his head to look towards Tai Ye.
"Lord Langdi probably won't see it."
"But it's not that the Baiyue emperor has a high self-esteem and deliberately neglects adults."
Zhunxian Tai Ye took a breath and said cautiously: "The two Emperor Wu have been in retreat for a long time.
Several Emperor Wu came to visit, but none of them saw them."
"That's it."
Su Lang nodded, "Then you go and come back to life, I will stroll around Baiyue Emperor City by myself."
"Yes!
Your lord!"
Tai Ye Zhunxian bowed in relief and flew away.
As soon as Su Lang moved, he flew forward, and soon merged into a'river' composed of escape light.
This ‘river’ is made up of warriors, densely packed, flying in the sky, and it really shows what is called a fantasy world.
Su Lang entered the city smoothly, and no one even came to investigate.
Walking on the streets in the city, Su Lang found that although there were a lot of people, it was not messy, and it looked very organized.
A large number of people of different races walked on the street.
Those with horns on their heads, those with blooming foreheads, those with wings on their backs, those with four arms, those with a long tail on their buttocks...
Su Langduo glanced at the long-tailed girl, and remembered the Foxtail tribe he had seen in the Jinwen Clan Teleportation Array.
Looking at the warriors of different races coming and going around, this scene is somewhat similar to the original one.
Su Lang walked around slowly and found that the cultivation resources here are indeed much richer than those in the south.
After walking a few steps in this way, I saw several materials that I had never seen before.
And among the various resources, the resource of refining was the most abundant, which made Su Lang couldn't help but have the idea of fishing here.
"My super humanoid weapon just lacks a lot of materials."

"Although the resources of the thirteen saints and one immortal land are all collected through the exchange building, and sooner or later I can gather it, but it will take time to accumulate after all."

"In addition, I have already learned the formation of the Red Lotus Emperor clan secretly, and there is still here, and there will be the Emperor Wu Palace later, but I did not have enough materials after learning the formation, which is really a pity."
"There are many kinds of refining materials here, the quantity is large, and the price is generally low.
You can do a wave!"
Su Lang licked his lips, and could no longer suppress this thought.
However, he didn't forget the business, and planned to learn the formation of the Baiyue Emperor City first.
So he rose into the air and flew towards the center of the Baiyue Emperor City.

The Baiyue Emperor City is open, but it also has a place that is not open, that is, the ‘administrative center’ here, where there are the Baiyue Emperor Clan warriors who are responsible for managing the city and deterring those with ghosts.
Su Lang soon arrived in the center of the city.
There stood a huge gate straight into the sky.
At first glance, it looks like an enlarged version of the Arc de Triomphe, but the carvings on it are completely different, revealing an ancient feeling.

chapters.title: Chapter 846: Five Elements United Imperial Formation
paragraphs: This giant gate is a real imperial soldier named Baiyue Emperor Sect!
Before the two White Moon Emperor Wu retired, they placed it in the White Moon Emperor City and guarded the whole city!
The weapon spirit of the Imperial Army is clear about the actions of all the warriors in the city, which can be called a super intelligent monitoring!
Once an enemy is found, the imperial soldier will directly take action to obliterate it.
Unless Emperor Wu comes, no one can hold an emperor soldier!
The White Moon Emperor Gate is the reason why the White Moon Emperor City is open to everyone, but it is very stable.
At this moment, Su Lang was staring at the Baiyue Emperor Sect.
It was the first time he saw a real imperial soldier, so he was very interested!
Through the ‘weapon recognition’ function, Su Lang saw the Baiyue Emperor’s Gate thoroughly from bottom to top, from left to right, from inside to outside!
"It's worthy of being an emperor soldier!"
"My quasi-imperial soldier, the sea of sky and the scabbard of Slaughter Heaven, are far behind them by more than ten thousand miles!"
Su Lang stared at the Baiyue Emperor's door with beaming eyes, and continued to chuckle.
at this time.
He suddenly felt a coercion falling on his body, a kind of death crisis swept through and enveloped his body.
In the coercion, there is still a little shy feeling!
"Ok?"
"Are you ashamed?"
"Is it because I was seen out?"
"But you are just a door, why should you be like a pure girl?"
Su Lang secretly complained, and then rolled his eyes again, and found that the spirit of the Baiyue Emperor's door really looked like a girl.
She seemed to be a entrenched in the sky, looking down at Su Lang, threatening her life, not allowing Su Lang to look at her again.
"Tsk tusk, dare to threaten me!"
"After Xiaoyou evolves into an emperor soldier, I will bring it over and let it use Sao language to teach the spirit of the Emperor Baiyue Sect.
Su Lang curled his lips, retracted his gaze, and immediately walked aside around the Baiyue Emperor Gate.
There stood a white palace.
The palace seems to be unattended, but if you feel it carefully, you can notice that there is spirituality sweeping around all the time.
In a short time.
Su Lang has been detected by five or six Wuxian level mental powers.
However, Su Lang only stood in the distance to admire the palace, so the martial arts did not expel Su Lang.
At this moment.
Su Lang was looking up at the palace. To be precise, he was looking at the formation.
This palace is equipped with the emperor-level exercises and immortal-level exercises that Su Lang needs.
At this time, the formation method converged, and the coverage was very narrow, but once there was a war, it would immediately cover the entire White Moon Emperor City.
Not long.
Su Lang took the formation and peeled off the cocoon and saw it through.
The White Moon Emperor Clan is indeed a more powerful emperor than the Red Lotus Emperor Clan.
This united emperor rank formation is also stronger than the formation of the Honglian emperor clan.
It consists of five emperor-level formations and 120 immortal-level formations.
All formations are the most common gold, wood, water, fire, and earth attributes.
But don't look at the attributes that are very common, the attributes of the five elements are intertwined, regenerate and restrain each other, and are endless, extremely difficult.
Once it can't be destroyed by crushing force, then this formation will be able to heal continuously, never want to break the formation by attrition!
Even if there is only one fairy-level formation at the lowest level, a complete united emperor formation can be derived from this formation.
This actually already has the terrifying ability of a trace of blood rebirth!
In this regard, Su Lang couldn't help but applaud!
Because this united imperial formation has been completely learned by him.
"Next!"
"Just to earn a wave of refining materials, and then go back to the old nest to set up the formation."
Su Lang left the tall palace with an excited smile.
Walking down the street.
He touched his chin, thinking about how to earn materials.
Or use the previous method to refine finished products in exchange for materials?
That's too slow!
Besides, Su Lang is busy refining the parts of super humanoid weapons. Where can he refining goods to sell?
Think about it.
Walking into the bustling streets, Su Lang gradually had a plan.
"Build an exchange house!"
"However, the exchange ratio needs to be adjusted. We cannot give benefits to strangers here. They are not mine."
"We must first look at the value difference between low-level materials and high-level materials."
While thinking, Su Lang walked into the material shop next to him.
No one came to meet and introduce.
The prices of materials are clearly marked.
Su Lang's mental strength swept away, and he knew all the material prices.
He walked out of the store, entered another one, and conducted ‘market research’ in the same way.

chapters.title: Chapter 847: The shopkeeper is crazy
paragraphs: Not long.
He visited most of the material shops and had a clear understanding of the value of low-level materials and high-level materials.
Comparing the highest-level god-level materials with the lowest-level holy-level materials, the value of the latter is basically more than fifty times that of the former.
The difference in value between Saint-level materials and fairy-level materials is even greater, more than a hundred times!
The difference in value between the fairy-level materials and the emperor-level materials is more than one thousand!
In other words, a thousand pieces of the best fairy-level materials may not necessarily be exchanged for one piece of the lowest-level emperor-level materials!
Perhaps it was precisely because of this that Xiao Lutian risked his life to hide the emperor grade materials.
"Tsk tsk, I am really kind to the warriors under my command."
Su Lang smiled. The exchange rates he set up in the four places of Yaochi, Biyu, Qiushui, and Xincheng were all twenty to one, which was too low.
However, Su Lang did not intend to change it.
Anyway, it's also earning. It doesn't matter if people earn less.
Not long.
Su Lang determined the ratio of this new exchange building, and the ratio of material exchange for each level is different.
Moreover, he only deals with materials above the level.
The ratios were set at fifty to one, one hundred to one, and one thousand to one.
If the value difference is too great, Su Lang will also increase the ratio. Anyway, he has the function of ‘treasure recognition’, so he can see the value of the item at a glance.
After setting the ratio.
Su Lang spent one million fine jade and bought a three-story building in the most prosperous area.
Immediately after.
He sent a clone, turned into a virgin, and went outside to solicit business.
"The shopkeeper is crazy, I need to replace low-grade materials with high-grade materials, the ratio is incredible!"
"50 kinds of god-level materials can be exchanged for holy-level materials, and 100 kinds of holy-level materials can be exchanged for immortal-level materials..."
"While the shopkeeper is still going crazy, don't miss it when you pass by!"
The two avatars shouted outside, and they immediately attracted a lot of attention.
"What are you shouting!?"
"It's said that the shopkeeper is crazy, and exchange high-level materials for low-level materials!"
"How is it possible, who can do business here, who is not a human being, it is strange that they are crazy, the percentage set in their shop must be ridiculously high!"
"You guessed it wrong, the ratio set by others is low. As long as fifty pieces of God-level materials can be exchanged for a holy level...Eh! Eh! What are you running? Listen to me!"
"After listening to you, the materials will have to be replaced!"
Those who can open a shop here are not ordinary people, and it is definitely not a lie to dare to shout such slogans.
Therefore, the warriors said they didn't believe it, but their bodies rushed towards the store.
In the shop.
Su Lang temporarily transferred those clones who were burning copies of the exercises.
Let them change into various appearances, like tellers, sitting behind the counter, waiting to receive customers.
Soon, the warriors poured into the shop like a tide.
"The shopkeeper, the exchange ratio you said is true!?"
"Hello, I have fifty god-level materials, I hope to exchange for the same holy-level materials!"
"Get out of the way, I want to change fairy-level materials!"
A group of warriors crowded at the counter, some were consulting, and some were directly asking for exchange.
The avatars of Su Lang ignored those warriors who were skeptical, and directly began to handle business for those warriors who wanted to exchange.
quickly.
The first warrior exchanged one hundred and thirty-nine ordinary saint-level materials for one immortal-level material.
The other warriors suddenly knew that the ratio mentioned before was not an accurate figure, but was adjusted according to the value of the item.
However, this is still profitable, and it is also a huge benefit.
As long as the ratio is less than a number, they can earn a piece of material out of thin air!
therefore.
The warriors who saw the benefits went crazy and started to exchange materials.
Su Lang watched this scene in secret, only hating that he had too few clones, and he couldn't be too busy.
But fortunately, the martial artist is very efficient, so the exchange rate is very fast.
In Su Lang's storage space, there seemed to be a waterfall falling from the sky. The waterfall was composed of endless materials.

chapters.title: Chapter 848: Fire of the Sky
paragraphs: Su Lang's shop quickly became famous in the Baiyue Emperor City.
More and more people come to exchange!
There were even Wuxian stepping into the air, lining up the crowd, bringing thousands of immortal grade materials to exchange for emperor grade materials.
For these Wuxians who jumped in line, Su Lang didn't let them get out of the line.
After all, these are all big fat sheep, one thousand celestial grade materials, how many materials can be synthesized in Su Lang's hands?
If Wu Xian who was bombarded ran away, wouldn't Su Lang lose.
What's more, this is a world that talks about fists, and the privileges of advanced warriors are everywhere.
The exchange shop business is in full swing.
Although people do not understand why the shopkeepers here do such a ‘losing business’, it does not prevent them from taking advantage.
Su Lang looked at these fat sheep with joy in his heart.
Seeing that the exchange business here has been on the right track, Su Lang used his perfect possession to control a clone far in the far north.
This clone is the one who escorted Jiaodi.
Unfortunately, Su Lang did not see the Wudi Palace through this clone.
The avatar of Su Lang escorted Jiao Di to a snow-white far north, with magnificent aurora hanging in the sky.
Then two quasi emperors flew from the aurora to greet Jiao Di.
After the two quasi emperors received Jiao Di, they did not intend to invite Su Lang clone to be a guest at Wudi Palace.
Obviously, after learning that Su Lang is not the actor, Jiao Qin was very disappointed, and naturally did not want to see guests when he was in a bad mood.
Su Lang withdrew this clone with some regrets, and his consciousness returned directly to his deity.
"The exchange business in Baiyue Emperor City for a long time brought me a lot of high-level materials."
Su Lang looked at the materials in the storage space, thinking about arranging an emperor rank formation for the sea of sky.

And this formation is dominated by the five-element united imperial formation obtained from the Baiyue Emperor City, and the three emperor formations obtained from the Red Lotus Imperial City are combined to form a super emperor rank formation.

Su Lang's formation skills are countless times higher than that of the formation masters who set up the five elements of the Baiyue Emperor City and the united imperial formation, and are even higher than those of the Red Lotus Imperial City.
Therefore, these two sets of joint formations are simply mud pills kneaded at will in his hands, and he can knead whatever he wants.
However, before that, Su Lang had another plan through the Five Elements United Imperial Formation.
At present, the sea of the sky is already a quasi-emperor-level immortal weapon, but the guardian scope is only the land of the Three Saints.
This range is far less than one-fifth of Su Lang's forces.
From the beginning of the Biyu clan, to the death zone of the emperor in the north of Qiushixian Lake, there is no strong formation to guard.
Once an enemy comes in, there will be a piece of erosion immediately.
Therefore, Su Lang wanted to take advantage of this time to update the formation, and by the way, also guard the land of Qiuxian Lake.
The approach is simple.
In order to cater to the upcoming joint emperor rank formation, Su Lang plans to refine four more quasi emperor soldiers!
The sea of sky belongs to the water attribute quasi-imperial soldier.
Then, by refining the Jinmuhuotu quasi-imperial army, he can correspond one-to-one with the five-element imperial formation and exert the strongest power.
Just do it.
Su Lang temporarily put aside the refining of super humanoid weapons and began refining four new quasi-imperial soldiers.
These four quasi-imperial soldiers are similar to the sea of sky, and the refining process is also very similar, but the materials used are different.
Therefore, Su Lang quickly refined the second weapon in the'Sky Weapon' series.
Just after being refined, it was a quasi-immortal weapon, and immediately Su Lang used the weapon evolution ability to evolve it into a quasi-imperial soldier!
This quasi-imperial soldier has a fire attribute, and its body is also snowflake-shaped, but its color is fiery red, which Su Lang called it the "flame of the sky".
"This time, the spirit of the instrument, don't be a little mentally retarded."
In Su Lang's expectant eyes, a brand-new spirit appeared.
Qi Ling still looks like a ‘crystal bun’, without a face, just a simple dumpling.
It is full of joy and agility, and it is very curious about its surroundings.
Moreover, it seems to be very impatient and has the characteristics of'fire'.
"With the lessons learned, you can't talk casually this time. It would be bad if you let it learn to shout."
Su Lang closed his mouth, observed the spirit of the sky flame, and named it "Xiao Yan".
Soon, he planned to take it back and start refining the third weapon.

This quasi-imperial soldier has a fire attribute, and its body is also snowflake-shaped, but its color is fiery red, which Su Lang called it the "flame of the sky".
"This time, the spirit of the instrument, don't be a little mentally retarded."
In Su Lang's expectant eyes, a brand-new spirit appeared.
Qi Ling still looks like a ‘crystal bun’, without a face, just a simple dumpling.
It is full of joy and agility, and it is very curious about its surroundings.
Moreover, it seems to be very impatient and has the characteristics of'fire'.
"With the lessons learned, you can't talk casually this time.
It would be bad if you let it learn to shout."
Su Lang closed his mouth, observed the spirit of the sky flame, and named it "Xiao Yan".
Soon, he planned to take it back and start refining the third weapon.

chapters.title: Chapter 849: All with minor mental retardation!
paragraphs: But at this moment.
Accompanied by a "Ma Ma Ma Ma", excited Xiao Hai appeared in front of Su Lang.
It excitedly flew around the new spirit ‘Xiao Yan’, exuding the joy of seeing the same kind.
"I fork, why is this stuff here!"
Su Lang's complexion was dark, and his instinct was bad.
But before he had time to react, he saw the new device spirit'Xiao Yan' wriggling, transforming his facial features exactly like Xiao Hai!
How did Xiaohai's five senses come from?
It is like Su Lang, pinching its face!
So now, Xiao Yan's face is exactly the same as Su Lang.
At the same time, it also learned Xiao Hai’s mantra, shouting ‘Ma Ma Ma Ma’, and even louder than Xiao Hai!
"This Nima!"
"Why is it like this again, how can the quasi-emperor soldiers refined by my dignified Primordial Realm refiner still mentally retarded!?"
Su Lang stared with a pair of eyes, and the corners of his mouth twitched constantly.
With the thought of'surely something is wrong', Su Lang began to think about why this happened.
He first thought of the weapon spirit of the Emperor Baiyue Gate.
It was an instrumental spirit who turned into a girl, with complete intelligence and perfect personality.
Then there is the spirit of the Slaughter Sky Sword Sheath, although it is not smart, but it can talk appropriately.
Looking at Youtianjian Xiaoyou again, he was overly clever and he kept talking all day long.
There is also the spirit of the White Jade Fairy Palace, quiet and quiet, like a lady.
Finally, Su Lang thought of Xiao Pao again.
There seems to be something wrong with Qi Ling Xiao Pao’s wit, and he always likes to yell ‘fire cannon’...
After some summary.
Su Lang finally found some rules
——It seems that all weapons made by combining ‘parts’ have something wrong with their spirit!
On the other hand, the Youtian Sword, the White Jade Immortal Palace, the Slaughter Sky Sword Sheath, and the White Moon Emperor Gate, their wits are all relatively normal.
The essence of these weapons is ‘a whole’, not a combination of parts.
"That's it!"
Su Lang suddenly realized.
Then, he looked a little sad: "It seems that the remaining three five-element weapons in the'Sky Series' are all with minor mental retardation.
Moreover, the super humanoid weapon is composed of 120,000 parts, and I am afraid that it will not raise a large mental retardation! ? "
Su Lang's eyes twitched when he thought that the super humanoid weapon that ruined the world had an abnormal mental retardation spirit.
That has to be watched at any time, otherwise, in case of a whim and tear down the house like Erha, wouldn't it be over?
But even if he knew that the three artifact spirits that were about to appear would likely be minor mentally retarded, Su Lang had no choice but to continue refining.
After all, the "flames of the sky" have been refined, so you can't give up halfway, right?
"Fortunately, Chu Xiaobei and the others can bring these spirits."
Su Lang took a deep breath and took out a series of metallic materials, intending to refine the'Gold of the Sky'.
However, at this moment.
Pleasant system prompts resounded through my mind.
"Ding! "Burning Soul and Solitary Lamp Jue" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "The Immortal Code of Immortality in the Beginning"..."
"Ding!..."
"Ding! "The Secret of the Wish" has reached the founding level!"
There are a total of seven system prompts, which means that the seven exercises that Su Lang placed before have been practiced.
Su Lang quickly put down the materials in his hands, looked at himself and checked the changes.
He only felt seven strange energies appearing in his body, running along the limbs and hundreds of skeletons, blending into every cell, and infiltrating the Martial Saint Realm.
In the end, these seven energies merged into the sea like a big river, disappearing into Su Lang's body.
"My combat power has increased again!"
Su Lang could clearly feel that he was in control of a more powerful force.
However, he was not busy opening the attribute panel to view it, because the rules corresponding to these exercises have not yet been understood!
Su Lang has understood the rules corresponding to "Burning Soul and Solitary Lamp Jue" and "Frozen Jade Immortal Yuan Zhenlu", and choosing them is of other use.
There is no corresponding rule in "The Great Beginning of the Immortal Code", it is entirely because Su Lang wants to try to see if he can improve his aptitude.
The remaining four books are "The Immortal Code of Ten Thousand Qis", "The Immortal Jue of Life and Immortality", "The Immortal Jue of Futian" and "The Secret of Wish of Immortals".
The corresponding rules are the ‘rules of qi’, the ‘rules of life’, the ‘radiation rules’, and the ‘rules of willingness’.
At this time, the practice of the exercises is completed, and the rules can be understood.

chapters.title: Chapter 850: Comprehend the rules of life
paragraphs: Su Lang waited for this moment for too long!
Although it has only been a day, he just feels that for a long time...
It took less than ten minutes, and Su Lang understood these four rules one by one.
Immediately, the four heaven and earth rules merged into Su Lang's body, and Su Lang suddenly mastered these four heaven and earth powers.
The rules of qi increase its energy reserves geometrically, and it has the effect of enhancing the energy texture, and even improving the body.
The rule of life corresponds to the rule of death, so Su Lang can see the'breath of life' more clearly.
Unfortunately, the rules of life comprehended at this time are very superficial.
Su Lang couldn't give the breath of life to the dead and turn them into creatures.
That method is too bad!
Su Lang estimated that if he became an emperor with the "Road of Life", he might be able to create creatures out of thin air.
But I am afraid it is impossible to create a wise creature out of thin air like the Lord Nuwa in Su Lang's previous life of the Chinese God Family!
Su Lang now masters the rules of life, and can see the breath of life more clearly.
Seeing the breath of life, mastering the rules of death can also do it.
But to master the rules of death, you can only see the breath of life in general, and have the means to strip it and annihilate it.
The breath of life is a collective term, there are many types!
Su Lang, who has mastered the rules of life, can separate or merge the breath of life with little difference.
To put it simply, this is a very abnormal healing ability.
The breath of life in a severely wounded and dying life is very weak. After Dan is replenished, it is like adding blood on the spot. It takes almost no time to restore health.
This ability can also be used on oneself!
Su Lang thought of his clone for the first time!
With a thought, he summoned a clone to his eyes, and used the rules of life to check it.
turn out.
The breath of the clone's birth is exactly the same as the breath of his own birth!
In other words, Su Lang can use the clone as a great medicine to ‘take’ when he heals his injuries.
It sounds a bit evil, but it is an important hole card.
Although Su Lang has the two heaven-defending abilities of ‘Swallowing Clone’ and ‘Death Replacement’, the healing ability of the Rule of Life seems redundant, but it is not!
Because of Su Lang's clones, only thirty can be used to swallow and die, and the other thirty are clones that can only be used for fighting.
Once Su Lang used the Devouring Clone, with only one Clone as a substitute for death, he still encountered a close battle.
Then, the avatar became Su Lang's "super battery life" drug.
The'breath of life' of a clone incarnation can completely fill Su Lang with blood.
In this way, the thirty clone avatars also possess the ability of'death substitution' in disguise.
Even if necessary, Su Lang could ingest the breath of life similar to his own from other creatures to heal his wounds.
But that has the meaning of "eating people." Unless it is an enemy, when Su Lang is less than a billion people, he will definitely not do that.
"The mastery of the rules of life makes me almost conducive to the land of immortality!"
"Or if you can become an emperor with the Great Way of Life...Tsk Tsk, it's really tempting.
Su Lang licked his lips with excitement, and immediately checked the two rules behind.
The first is the ‘radiation rule’.
Radiation is everywhere, and it can be called a basic rule of the world.
It has a strong ability to increase Su Lang's "spell attack".
Radiation is invisible and quality, invisible to the naked eye, but it carries terrifying penetrating energy, which is hard to prevent.
In Su Lang's view, the radiation rules are equivalent to adding a strong ‘spell penetration’ attribute to him.
This greatly increased Su Lang's combat power.
Let's talk about the rules of willingness.
Su Lang felt that this rule would be very important from the beginning.
After grasping at this time, I know that it is really very important.
The rules of wishing power are related to the incense of sentient beings!
But all creatures have souls, and every thought, any thought, will exude aspiration.
Aspiration itself has no attributes and has nothing to do with fighting.
But it can be called omnipotent almighty energy!
As long as it gathers to a certain level, the controller can do everything with it, and even live forever!
